issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — Radix a11y hint, not a functional bug. Consider adding <DialogDescription> for screen-reader friendliness.

critical_code_review_comments: hr.py repair_payslip_journals is ~225 lines and mixes diagnostics + 3 mutation passes; consider extracting _compute_diagnostics(db) helper for reuse in a future read-only GET endpoint so the frontend can poll state without hitting the mutation path.
financial.py update_expense whitelist accepts both 'vendor' and 'vendor_name' — dual fields risk drift. Suggest picking one canonical name and aliasing.

FinancialPage.jsx Edit dialog: fin-edit-account-tag/dept/budget live inside a <details> block (Advanced). They're in DOM regardless of open state (good for testing) but consider persisting the open-state per session so users don't have to re-expand each edit.
